"""Public policy language: lexical form, grammar and declared per-string bounds.

The module performs no predicate evaluation and builds no automata; it turns a
policy string into a rule list ``[(predicate, allow), ...]`` and reports the
atom/path-service occurrence counts used by the whole-request budget.

Grammar (the only ignored whitespace between tokens is space, tab, form feed,
CR and LF)::

    policy*      := (predicate action ";")*
    predicate    := "(" predicate ("and"|"or") predicate ")" | "not" "(" predicate ")" | atom
    atom         := ("match"|"startswith"|"endswith"|"contains") "(" [NAME ("," NAME)*] ")"
    action       := "allow" | "drop"

Declared bounds (violations reject that policy):

* predicate nesting depth at most 16, an atom has depth 1;
* every path has at most 16 services, a non-``match`` atom at most 4;
* at most 8 rules whose predicate is not a single ``match`` atom, each such
  predicate holding at most 32 atom occurrences;
* at most 4 distinct non-``match`` atoms per string;
* at most 32768 atom occurrences and 65536 path-service occurrences per string.
"""
import re

__all__ = ['PolicyError', 'RegistryError', 'parse', 'check_registry', 'rule_atoms',
           'MAX_ATOMS', 'MAX_PATH_SERVICES', 'MAX_DEPTH', 'MAX_PATH',
           'MAX_COMPLEX_RULES', 'MAX_COMPLEX_ATOMS', 'MAX_DISTINCT_NONLITERAL',
           'MAX_NONLITERAL_PATH', 'ATOM_KINDS', 'NAME_FORM']

NAME_FORM = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23}\Z')
ATOM_KINDS = ('match', 'startswith', 'endswith', 'contains')
_KEYWORDS = frozenset(ATOM_KINDS + ('and', 'or', 'not', 'allow', 'drop'))

MAX_DEPTH = 16
MAX_PATH = 16
MAX_COMPLEX_RULES = 8
MAX_COMPLEX_ATOMS = 32
MAX_DISTINCT_NONLITERAL = 4
MAX_NONLITERAL_PATH = 4
MAX_ATOMS = 32768
MAX_PATH_SERVICES = 65536
# A policy that satisfies every bound above needs far fewer tokens than this,
# so the cap only stops a hostile string from exhausting memory first.
MAX_TOKENS = 500000

# Whitespace, an identifier, or one piece of punctuation.  Any other character
# (vertical tab, non-ASCII space, stray punctuation) has no token at all and is
# therefore a syntax error, exactly as the contract requires.
_TOKEN = re.compile(r'[ \t\f\r\n]+|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*|[();,]')
_IDENT = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\Z')


class PolicyError(ValueError):
    """Syntax or declared policy-bound violation; rejects that stage event."""


class RegistryError(PolicyError):
    """Syntactically valid policy naming a service the registry does not have."""
